Next week, the iPhone Ultra will be unveiled at Apple’s September event, and today a new Tom’s Guide interview with Mark Gurman reveals several fresh details on what to expect from specs, software, launch timing, and more.

Here’s what’s coming with iPhone Ultra, per Mark Gurman

One week out from iPhone Ultra’s introduction, there are still new leaks arriving. Today in a new interview with Tom’s Guide, Mark Gurman shared a variety of tidbits—including some details not reported before.

MagSafe, for example, has been a recent question mark for iPhone Ultra. But Gurman was quick to say MagSafe won’t be absent. “MagSafe is there. Yeah, all indications that I’ve heard is that MagSafe is in for this foldable phone.”

When asked about specs for the iPhone Ultra, Gurman mentions:

  • 5.5-inch cover display and 7.8-inch inner display
  • “Latest Apple Pro chip and latest Apple modem”

He also talks about two key features: the rumored “crease-less” display and liquid metal hinge. He says the crease isn’t entirely gone, but it’s comparable to the new Samsung foldables and might be even better thanks to the more durable hinge.

On the note of the hinge and durability, he adds:

Multitasking was another key area addressed in the interview. Gurman previously reported that iOS 27 will enable iPad-like app layouts and side-by-side app multitasking. Today he adds that drag and drop will be supported between multiple on-screen apps, so you can quickly move data from one app to another.
